text: F02.2 handoff: V008 now stores the sole principal registry, memberships/participations with lineage and expiry, private placement, explicit stewardship and independent legacy grants. The governed SQL branch deliberately supports only explicit stewards plus exact grants; ProjectMembers can be recorded but grants no inherited reads yet. F03.1 must implement the complete ADR 38-case role/action/provenance decision contract, then F03.2 should use that same decision model rather than grow a separate SQL-only policy implementation. See docs/organization-reference.md and docs/decisions/004-policy-durability.md.
